questions.explanation: Mia开口说“Good morning.”，是早上问候语。不是Good evening（晚上好）或Good night（晚安）。原文没有直接交代Mia的职业，因此不再把help desk person当作必须听出的身份。
questions.evidence: Mia: Good morning. I am Mia. Are you a visitor?

questions.explanation: Ben最初说“I am here for Room 12.”，表示他是来找12号房间的；Mia随后才纠正为另一房间。题目问他最先说出的房号，不是纠正后的房号。
questions.evidence: Ben: Yes. I am Ben. I am here for Room 12.

questions.explanation: Mia明确纠正：“Room 12? No. You are in Room 14.”。题目问Mia所说的房间，应听纠正后的信息；不是Ben最初说的Room 12，也不是Room 4。
questions.evidence: Mia: Room 12? No. You are in Room 14.

questions.explanation: Mia问Ben是否和一位friend一起，Ben紧接着回答“Yes.”，确认了这件事。用录音原词填friend；不能只引用问句就把问题中的信息当作已经证实。
questions.evidence:
Mia: Are you with a friend?
Ben: Yes. We are here. We are two people.

questions.explanation: Ben说“We are two people.”，所以填two。题目限定Ben所说的we，不把正在与他们交谈的Mia也计入；填原词，不填people或three。
questions.evidence: Ben: Yes. We are here. We are two people.

questions.explanation: Mia说14号房间在二楼。
questions.evidence: Mia: Good. You are in Room 14. It is on floor two.

questions.explanation: Ben问是否靠近楼梯，Mia回答是的。
questions.evidence:
Ben: Is it near the stairs?
Mia: Yes, it is. The stairs are there.

questions.explanation: Ben说他们很高兴。
questions.evidence: Ben: Great. We are happy. Thank you, Mia.

questions.explanation: Mia问'Are you the building manager?'，Mr. Lee回答'Yes, I am.'，所以他是building manager。
questions.evidence:
Mia: Hello. I am new here. Are you the building manager?
Mr. Lee: Yes, I am. I am Lee.

questions.explanation: Mia说'I am not a student. I am a nurse.'，明确否定她是学生。
questions.evidence: Mia: Yes, I am. But I am not a student. I am a nurse.

questions.explanation: Mia说'I am a nurse.'，所以她的职业是护士。
questions.evidence: Mia: Yes, I am. But I am not a student. I am a nurse.

questions.explanation: Mr. Lee问'Is there a hospital near here?'，Mia回答'Yes, there is.'，所以附近有医院。
questions.evidence:
Mr. Lee: Oh, good. Is there a hospital near here?
Mia: Yes, there is. It is not far.

questions.explanation: Mia问'Who is the doctor there?'，Mr. Lee回答'Dr. Chen.'，所以医生是Dr. Chen。
questions.evidence:
Mia: Yes, there is. It is not far. Who is the doctor there?
Mr. Lee: Dr. Chen. She is very nice.

questions.explanation: Mr. Lee问'Are you tired?'，Mia回答'No, I am not.'，所以她不累。
questions.evidence:
Mr. Lee: Dr. Chen. She is very nice. Are you tired?
Mia: No, I am not.

questions.explanation: Mr. Lee说公交站“It is next to the bank.”，next to表示紧挨着，因此选The bank。医院是near（附近）的参照点，不能把near自动改成next to；原文没有说公交站紧挨学校。
questions.evidence:
Mia: No, I am not. Is the bus stop near the hospital?
Mr. Lee: Yes, it is. It is next to the bank.

questions.explanation: Mr. Lee说'The bank is not open today.'，所以银行今天不开门。
questions.evidence: Mr. Lee: Yes, it is. It is next to the bank. The bank is not open today.

questions.explanation: Leo说“I work Monday to Friday.”，所以正常一周工作周一到周五。
questions.evidence: I work Monday to Friday.

questions.explanation: Leo说“My sister visits on Thursday. So I stay home on Thursday.”，因此这周周四留在家里是因为姐妹来访。sister本身不区分姐姐或妹妹；健身、学英语是谈话中的其他活动，不是这句话给出的原因。
questions.evidence: My sister visits on Thursday. So I stay home on Thursday.

questions.explanation: Mia问“Do you go to the gym on Thursday?”，Leo回答“No, I don't.”，所以周四不去健身房。
questions.evidence:
Mia: Do you go to the gym on Thursday?
Leo: No, I don't. I go to the gym on Tuesday and Friday.

questions.explanation: Leo说“I start at nine.”，所以开始工作是九点。答案填nine。
questions.evidence: I start at nine.

questions.explanation: Leo说“I finish at five.”，所以下班是五点。答案填five。
questions.evidence: I finish at five.

questions.explanation: Leo说“I eat lunch at a café near my office.”，所以午饭在办公室附近的咖啡馆吃。
questions.evidence: I eat lunch at a café near my office.

questions.explanation: Leo说“I study English on Monday and Wednesday.”，所以周一和周三学英语。
questions.evidence: I study English on Monday and Wednesday.

questions.explanation: Leo说“I don't study on Friday.”，所以周五不学英语。
questions.evidence: I don't study on Friday.

questions.explanation: 原文中Mia说“My son likes noodles”，所以儿子喜欢面条。
questions.evidence: My son likes noodles

questions.explanation: 原文中Mia说儿子“cannot eat eggs”，所以儿子不能吃鸡蛋。
questions.evidence: Mia: My son likes noodles, but he cannot eat eggs.

questions.explanation: Tom问“Does she like vegetables?”，Mia回答“No, she doesn't.”，所以女儿不喜欢蔬菜。
questions.evidence: Tom: Rice with eggs. Does she like vegetables? Mia: No, she doesn't.

questions.explanation: Mia说“I like soup”，所以Mia喜欢汤。
questions.evidence: I like soup

questions.explanation: Tom问“Does your husband like soup?”，Mia回答“No, he doesn't.”，所以丈夫不喜欢汤。
questions.evidence: Tom: Chicken soup. Does your husband like soup? Mia: No, he doesn't.

questions.explanation: Mia说丈夫“likes bread and cheese”，所以丈夫喜欢面包和奶酪。
questions.evidence: Tom: Chicken soup. Does your husband like soup? Mia: No, he doesn't. He likes bread and cheese.

questions.explanation: Tom问“does he eat fish?”，Mia回答“Yes, he does.”，所以丈夫吃鱼。
questions.evidence: Tom: Chicken soup. Does your husband like soup? Mia: No, he doesn't. He likes bread and cheese. Tom: Bread and cheese. One more thing: does he eat fish? Mia: Yes, he does.

questions.explanation: Mia说丈夫“cannot eat nuts”，所以丈夫不能吃坚果。答案填nuts。
questions.evidence: Tom: Chicken soup. Does your husband like soup? Mia: No, he doesn't. He likes bread and cheese. Tom: Bread and cheese. One more thing: does he eat fish? Mia: Yes, he does. But he cannot eat nuts.

questions.explanation: Tom 明确说 art room 在图书馆旁边。
questions.evidence: Mia: Excuse me, Tom. Where is the art room? Tom: It is next to the library.

questions.explanation: Tom 指路时说在咖啡馆左转。
questions.evidence: Go straight and turn left at the café.

questions.explanation: Tom 回答 Yes, there is，说明门口附近有地图。
questions.evidence: Mia: Is there a map near the gate? Tom: Yes, there is.

questions.explanation: Tom 说两个学生正在地图上画画。
questions.evidence: Mia: Is there a map near the gate? Tom: Yes, there is. Look, two students are drawing on it.

questions.explanation: Tom 明确说没有椅子。
questions.evidence: Mia: Are there any chairs in the art room? Tom: No, there aren't.

questions.explanation: Tom 说艺术教室里有六张桌子，原文用 six。
questions.evidence: there are six tables.

questions.explanation: Tom 说老师正在开窗。
questions.evidence: Mia: What is the teacher doing now? Tom: She is opening the window.

questions.explanation: Tom 说自己的包在桌子下面。
questions.evidence: My bag is under the desk.

questions.explanation: Ben说：'I'm near the big market.' 所以选“near the big market”。
questions.evidence: I'm near the big market.

questions.explanation: Mia问：'Is there a coffee shop near you?' Ben回答：'Yes, there is.' 所以选“Yes, there is.”。
questions.evidence: Mia: Is there a coffee shop near you? Ben: Yes, there is.

questions.explanation: Ben说：'It's next to the bank.' 所以填bank。
questions.evidence: Mia: Is there a coffee shop near you? Ben: Yes, there is. It's next to the bank.

questions.explanation: Mia直接说“I'm at the bus stop.”，所以选at the bus stop。随后她正在走向市场；题目问她自己说出的地点，不把整段对话结束时的未知实时位置当作已知信息。
questions.evidence: I'm at the bus stop.

questions.explanation: Ben说：'The market is between the bank and the library.' 所以选“library”。
questions.evidence: The market is between the bank and the library.

questions.explanation: Mia问：'Is that the library?' Ben回答：'No, that's the hospital.' 所以选“No, it isn't.”。
questions.evidence: Mia: I see a tall building. Is that the library? Ben: No, that's the hospital.

questions.explanation: Ben说：'The library is behind the market.' 所以填behind。
questions.evidence: The library is behind the market.

questions.explanation: Ben说“I'm standing under the clock.”，因此他站在钟下面。问句只问他站在什么东西下面，避免把可能同时成立的near the bank与under the clock当作互斥地点；录音没有说他站在树或标牌下面。
questions.evidence: I'm standing under the clock.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“It was good.”，所以选“It was good.”。
questions.evidence: It was good.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“I was ten minutes late.”，所以填 ten 或 10。
questions.evidence: I was ten minutes late.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“Because my bus was slow.”，所以选“Because his bus was slow.”。
questions.evidence: Because my bus was slow.

questions.explanation: Mia 问“Were you nervous in class?”，Leo 回答“Yes, I was.”，所以选“Yes, he was.”。
questions.evidence:
Mia: Were you nervous in class?
Leo: Yes, I was.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“We listened to a short story. Then we talked in pairs.”，先听故事，所以选“They listened to a short story.”。
questions.evidence: We listened to a short story. Then we talked in pairs.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“I'm going to review new words because the test is on Friday.”，所以选“He is going to review new words.”。
questions.evidence: I'm going to review new words because the test is on Friday.

questions.explanation: Leo 说“the test is on Friday”，所以填 Friday。
questions.evidence: the test is on Friday

questions.explanation: Leo 最后说“Thanks, Mia. You were a big help.”，所以是 Mia。
questions.evidence: Thanks, Mia. You were a big help.
